consonants.name: giyeok
consonants.note: Lax velar stop. Word-initially [k], between vowels often [ɡ], coda [k̚].

consonants.name: digeut
consonants.note: Lax alveolar stop. Init [t], voiced [d] intervocalic, coda [t̚].

consonants.name: rieul
consonants.note: Flap [ɾ] between vowels; [l] in coda or geminate.

consonants.name: bieup
consonants.note: Lax bilabial stop. Init [p], voiced [b] intervocalic, coda [p̚].

consonants.name: ieung
consonants.note: Null onset initially; velar nasal [ŋ] in coda.

consonants.name: ssang-giyeok
consonants.note: Tense (fortis) velar. Higher F0, no aspiration.

vowels.name: eu
vowels.note: Close back unrounded. No English equivalent.

vowels.name: ae
vowels.note: Open-mid front. Merging with ㅔ for many speakers.

vowels.name: e
vowels.note: Close-mid front. Often merged with ㅐ.

sources: Hangul jamo and IPA: standard Seoul Korean (Lee & Ramsey; Shin, Kiaer, Cha).
Syllable composition: Unicode Hangul Syllables (U+AC00 algorithm).
Reading words: aligned with NIKL 한국어 학습용 어휘 목록 beginner band.
